I swear by the Day of Resurrection.
And I swear by the soul that blames itself.
Does man think We cannot put his bones back together?
Yes, We can! We can even make his fingertips exactly the same.
But man wants to say no to what is ahead of him.
He asks: When is the Day of Resurrection?
When the eyes are amazed.
And the moon loses its light.
And the sun and the moon are joined together.
On that Day man will say: Where can I run?
No! There is no place to hide.
To your Lord on that Day is the place where it all stops.
On that Day man will be told everything he sent ahead and everything he left behind.
And man will be a witness against himself.
Even if he gives his excuses.
Do not move your tongue with it to hurry to learn it.
It is up to Us to put it together and to have you read it.
Then when We have read it, follow what is read.
Then it is up to Us to explain it.
No! You love this fast life.
And you leave the next life.
Some faces on that Day will be bright.
Looking at their Lord.
And some faces on that Day will be sad.
They know that something terrible will happen to them.
When the soul reaches the top of the chest.
And it is said: Who can heal him?
And he knows it is the time to go.
And one leg is wrapped over the other leg.
To your Lord on that Day is the going.
He did not believe and did not pray.
But he said it was a lie and turned away.
Then he went to his family, full of pride.
How terrible for you, and more!
Then again, how terrible for you, and more!
Does man think he will be left without a purpose?
Was he not a drop of fluid poured out?
Then he became a clinging drop. And Allah made him and shaped him just right.
And made from him two kinds, male and female.
Is He not able to bring the dead back to life?
